translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Melquisedec, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledid

Ar we-Melquisedec, neggwebur-Salem-nugad-e-rey, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummad-Bur-Dummadidse-goled-duled. Abraham reymar-baid-ebo urwediidgi nakwis danigua, we-Melquisedec Abraham-abin-node-gusad, geb agi ega sogsad: “Bab Dummad nued begi binsaena-gadinye.”
Geb degine, Abraham bela-ibmar-nikad sogambe-gued-gwensak Melquisedecga uksad. Melquisedec sogleged: “Rey igar-inikii-imakedye,” degine, Salem-e-Reyye soglebalidi, sogledo: “Rey gwage-bogidikidye.”

We-Melquisedec dule wichulid doa e-baba, degine, doa e-nana, deginbali, e-dadgan-wichurmarbalid. Deginbali e-gwalulesad, degine, e-burgwisad dulemar gwen wichurmarbalid. A-ulale Bab-Dummad-Machiyobmosundo, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled degi-sadeguad-dulesundo.

Nue be itomalana, we-Melquisedecde bule-dumma be itosunna, anmar-dada, Abraham, dule-dummadye soged, reymar-baigan-ebo-ulusad-ibe ibmar-susad, degite, sogambe-gued-gwensak Bab-Dummadga-ukoye-sogleged Melquisedecga uksad.

Ar napiragwad, Leví-e-wagan, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga nugsalesmalad, amarga igar-maid, sogambe-gued-gwensak Bab-Dummadga-ukoye-sogleged ega uklegoye, e-gwenadgan ega ukoye, ar wemar amba Abrahamgi danimarmo-inigwer.

Ar Melquisedecdi Levígi danisur-inigwele, sogambe-gued-gwensak Bab-Dummadga-uklegoye-sogleged Abraham-annik susa-gusad. Degine, Abrahamga Bab Dummad sogsa-gusad, an bega ibmar-nuegan imakoye, a-dulega Melquisedec sogsa-gusad, Bab Dummad nued begi binsaena-gadinye.
Degine, dule we geg bengued, dule-dummad dule-bipigwadga sog-daed, Bab Dummad begi nued binsaena-gadinye.

Anmar-abargi dulemar-ibmar-sogambe-gued-gwensak-Bab-Dummadga-ukoye-sogleged-suedi, we burgwemalad. Melquisedec-nikdi Bab-Dummad-Garda egi sunmakedi amba dula gudiyob egi sunmakleged. Degisoggu, Melquisedecyobid Leví-waganba bur dummasundo.
Weyob soglegeyobsundo, ibmar-sogambe-gued-gwensak-Bab-Dummadga-uklegedi, Leví abingaedi, Leví uksamoye, Abraham deun Melquisedecga uksa-gusgu,
ar ade amba deun Leví e-dad-Abraham-sapi-dukugi maigu, Melquisedec Abraham-abin noar-gusad.

Leví-wagangi Israel-dulemar Moisés-igar-nika-megisad abingas-gusmalad. We-Leví-wagan-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, we nabir dule-nuedga imakena, ¿degite ibiga bar Melquisedecgiid, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled bar abelegoensunna? Emigindi, Aarón-wagansulid sulenonikid dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga guegar.
Ar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled ogwalenonikir, igar-maid amba ogwalemogar-gebed.
We anmar-Dummad-Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi egi sunmaked, we Leví-e-wagwasulid, baid e-dadad, wemardi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-gummakar-ukleged-galugi arbadisurmalad.
Ar anmar wisid, anmar-Dummad-Jesús, Judá-e-wagwad, agi nonikid. Judá-wagangindi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-golega Moisés egi gwen sunmaksasulid.
Jesús dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledi Melquisedecgiidid
Ar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-gwapid, Melquisedecgiid nonikile, we anmarse ise-nue-sogar oyolenaibarsundo.
We-dule-danikidi, e-dadgangi gwen danisulid. We-Cristo danikid, na gusgu e-gangued nikadba, geg-san-burba-bergued na nikadba. A-ulale, we-Cristo nugsalenonikid, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga guegar.
Agine, Bab-Dummad-Garda egi sunmaknaid:
Degisoggu, a-ulale, idu-igar-maid, osulolessunnad, ar ade nollogwad, degine, igarga geg bargubalid.
Ar Moisés-igar-maid gwen dule-bendaksasulid dule geg-bar-iskusaedgi nanaegar. Emigindi anmar ibmar-nued bensulidgi edarbedimarsunnad, agi, emigi anmar sunna Bab Dummadse warmakmarsunnad.
We-igar-uklesadi, Bab Dummad na e-sunnad sogsa-gusad, we an-sogedi, napiraye.

Ar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-baigangardi ega soglessulid, napira an bega sogye, an sogsad bar ogwaosurye, bemar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga gumaloye. Ar we-Dummad-Jesús, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga, agardi soglesad, napira an bega sogye, ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaid:
A-ulale, Bab Dummad napiraye Jesúsgi sogsadgi nue oyolenonisunnad, Bab Dummad dulemar-ebo igar-bini-mesisadi, epenne Moisésba-igar-mesisadba bur nuedye.
Leví-wagandi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad ichesur gunonikid, ar ade amar burgwemaladbali deyob gunonikid.
Ar Jesúsdi burgwesursoggu, edi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga degi-sadeguadga gunonisunnad.
A-ulale dulemar Jesús-nuggi Bab Dummadse danimalale, Jesús sunna degi-sadegu a-dulemar-abonosunnad, ar ade Jesús degi-sadegu dula gudigusoggu, amar-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gornaigu dasunnad.

Ar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad-weyobid anmar nika abeleged: Dule gwage-swilidikid, geg istar binsaed, dule e-gwagegi gutu-naisulid, dulemar-iskumaladgi aibacha-gudiid, degine, nibnegba bur-bule dule-dummadga imaklesbalid.

Ar bane-bane dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-bur-dummagan na e-iskudiidga ibmar Bab Dummadga ukmalad, geb a-sorba dulemar-baigan-iskudiidga ibmar Bab Dummadga ukde-damalad. Ar Jesúsdi deyobsulid, wedi unniguar bato na irgwen-ukar Bab Dummadga na san imaksad, adi dulemar-iskued osulogegar.

Ar Moisés-igar-mesisad dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-bur-dummad-nugsaedi, wemardi nolloo-gumalad. Ar Bab Dummad E-Machigi napiraye sogsaddi, we Moisés-igar-mesisad-sorbalidi, agi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga na E-Machi nug imaksad. Ar E-Machidi ibmar-gwen-akusuli, degi-sadegu na gudiguoed.
